spec.description: The job runs python3 examples/tools/build.py 306 --task mutant-replay, the target route of llm-dlc/loops/example-targets.md: workflow plans the task from target.json, runtime prepares each revision by the published-artifact route (every JAR acquired from Maven Central by the sha256 its sidecar pins, refused on a mismatch; driver and adapter compiled with --release 21), runs the packet's driver over its probes in a separate JVM per revision on JDK 21 and on JDK 25, and workflow ingests the records into one format-2 receipt under receipts/mutant-replay/, reading each revision's driver lines with the packet's independent oracle (controls/oracle.py problems()). A replay decides no claim: build.py exits 0 only when the receipt's matchesExpected is true, i.e. every revision ran on both JDKs, exited 0 with structured observations, and each shows what its pair's kind expects on both JDKs alike. No proof runs. This is Phase 5 step 1's first run of a real packet through the merged infrastructure; a failure in a stream's code is a finding to fix with a reproducer. Example 306's mutation pair: release-after (spring-core 5.3.7, b1280ffe) against the constructed mutant, 5.3.7 with controls/drop-prefix.patch applied (the prefix condition dropped). The mutant is a sensitivity control, never a revision of Spring. A4 needs the base to hold and the mutant to fail the same oracle.
